data.body: BuildKit cache follow-up 2026-09-09T12:41Z: CloudWatch rebar-docker-buildkit-cache-high re-fired after tonight's builds. Investigation found scaup's BuildKit scope is live: /etc/docker/daemon.json carries builder.gc.maxUsedSpace=5368709120, docker-storage-cap.sh reports the live Docker daemon started after the policy was written, so the cap is in effect. The alarm is a generator-over-cap alarm (threshold 85% of the 5 GiB BuildKit share), and docker system df showed Build Cache 5.756GB/5.362GB over the 5 GiB share while root still had ample headroom (24-31% used). Ran bounded docker builder prune -af; post-prune docker system df reports Build Cache Size=0B, Reclaimable=0B, TotalCount=0. Observability service ran successfully afterward; waiting for CloudWatch's 6-of-6 five-minute window to age out the prior breaching datapoints before recording final alarm-clear evidence.
